summary: Customer inquires about and resolves unexpected bank charge.

intents.keywords: Does a 200 rupees charge...What's this about?
issues: Unexpected charge of 200 rupees on savings account
reasons (identified by agent): Maintenance fee due to low balance (below 10000 rupees)
actions of agent: Asked for account number to investigate.
Identified the charge as a maintenance fee.
Offered to waive the fee as a one-time courtesy.
Offered to set up balance alerts.
intents.resolution: The agent waived the 200 rupees maintenance fee.
intents.agent professionalism: The agent was polite and helpful in resolving the issue.
